answer: The ledger locks 500 credits per identity. When fraud proofs land in one audit window set by the chain's beacon, it slashes 10% per identity caught, capped at 100%. One bot mislabeling nebula images loses 50; n fakes caught together lose 50n², so the n-th adds about 100n. Locked stake can't be shared or reset, and coordinated fakes strike in the same window, where even a forged plume reading joins the public count. No ownership proof is needed.
